title: unified-supervisor QA runner config
description: Isolated binaries and state roots for bun scripts/qa/unified-supervisor.mjs. The runner enforces this schema itself: unknown fields, missing required fields, relative or ~ paths, any path naming hub.sqlite, roots inside or containing production locations (~/.ferryx, Ferryx/mhc app-data and XDG directories, the daemon runtime roots /tmp/ferryx-<uid>[-dev] and /tmp/rorca-<uid>, the invoking shell's FERRYX_* locations; symlinks are resolved) or the home directory, overlapping roots, a dataRoot too long for the isolated daemon socket (100 bytes) and a dataRoot/memoryRoot already holding state this runner did not create are refused with exit 2 before anything is written.

ferryxCli.description: Absolute path of the ferryx-cli binary built from the recorded source revision. The admission scenario runs it as the isolated daemon (--daemon, with its hub and supervisor dispatcher), as `supervisor setup` and as the owner's `mcp` channel; build it with the default hub features.

ferryxApp.description: Absolute path of the Ferryx desktop binary or app bundle from the same revision; directories are tree-hashed.

mhcBin.description: Absolute path of the mhc binary from the pinned capability-bearing revision.

ferryxRelay.description: Absolute path of the ferryx-relay binary from the same revision (debug build: the paired daemons need FERRYX_ALLOW_INSECURE_RELAY for a loopback ws:// relay). Required by remote-delivery, which runs it on a free loopback port to pair two isolated daemons; that scenario refuses to run without it (CONFIG_INVALID).

dataRoot.description: Task-owned isolated Ferryx data root: absent or holding only .qa-unified-supervisor/ and runs/. Holds the ownership ledger (.qa-unified-supervisor/owned.jsonl) and per-run roots (runs/<runId>) that teardown removes. <dataRoot>/runs/<24-char runId>/runtime/daemon.sock must fit in 100 bytes.

memoryRoot.description: Task-owned isolated mhc memory root (absent or holding only runs/); per-run roots live under runs/<runId>.

projectRoot.description: Task-owned project/worktree root for the qa-supervisor fixture project.

pairedHostId.description: Paired host id for remote scenarios (remote-delivery, channels).

ownerPrincipal.description: Authenticated owner principal used by fixtures, e.g. qa-owner. The admission scenario sets up the isolated installation's supervisor identity for it.

slackChannel.description: Dedicated QA Slack channel approved in the current execution session; omit or null when no approval exists.
